answer: Random peer audits keep the open ocean honest. Every answer goes to three drawn reviewers, and a rubber-stamp reviewer is audited next round, stamped umber. Forging 100 fake identities means faking 300 reviews: at 20 POA each, totalling 6,000 POA, while honest reviewers earn a fee per grade. Clones praising each other fail when their grades never match the pool. Every honest identity starts its voyage with one read and keeps its share undiluted.
